 Carlos Alcaraz is in Spain’s team for the Davis Cup Final 8 in Bologna next month. That means he’s slated to play in the competition for the first time in two years. Alexander Zverev headlines Germany. He's guaranteed to take over the No. 1 ranking before the Nov. 24-29 event. Three-time defending champion Italy will be without the injured Jannik Sinner. Italy will be led by French Open runner-up Flavio Cobolli. Alcaraz hasn’t played in the Davis Cup since the 2024 Final 8. Spain’s squad features two other top-15 players, No. 11 Rafael Jodar and No. 15 Alejandro Davidovich Fokina.

 BOLOGNA, Italy (AP) — Carlos Alcaraz was in Spain’s team for the Davis Cup Final 8 next month, meaning he’s slated to play in the competition for the first time in two years.
 Alexander Zverev, who is guaranteed to take over the No. 1 ranking before the Nov. 24-29 event in Bologna, was named to Germany’s team in Monday’s squad announcements.
